description: Train a SynFit multi-objective protein fitness model from a DMS CSV.
functions: Two-stage training: Stage 1 trains a per-objective baseline head (BT loss + KL anchor), Stage 2 jointly fine-tunes the shared encoder across both objectives.
Requires exactly 2 DMS_score_* columns in the input CSV - SynFit's joint model is hardcoded to 2 heads.
Backbone: facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D, pre-cached in the image.
Outputs a zip with Stage-1 checkpoints, Stage-2 joint checkpoint (use this with SynFit-Predict), and per-epoch Spearman logs for every fold requested.
Single L40S GPU (48 GB VRAM) - the paper uses multi-GPU for Stage 2; this runs DataParallel on one device. L40S is faster to schedule on Tamarind than A100.

inputs.name: training_csv
inputs.descr: DMS dataset in SynFit format: must have 'mutant' (e.g. 'A126C'), 'mutated_sequence' (full variant sequence), and exactly two 'DMS_score_*' columns - one per objective. See dataset/multi_fitness_data/ in the SynFit repo for examples.

inputs.name: protein_name
inputs.descr: Identifier used for output folder naming. Letters, numbers, and underscores.

inputs.name: num_folds
inputs.descr: Number of CV folds to run (1-5). 1 fold trains a single model fast; 5 folds reproduces the paper. Each fold runs Stage 1 (2 baselines) then Stage 2.

inputs.name: max_epochs_stage1
inputs.descr: Maximum epochs per per-objective baseline (Stage 1). Early-stopping kicks in after 10 epochs without validation Spearman improvement.

inputs.name: max_epochs_stage2
inputs.descr: Maximum epochs for the joint shared-module training (Stage 2). Early-stopping at 10 epochs without improvement.
